frases.texto: In this work, we focus on a novel task of mining from a review corpus sentences that are unique for each entity.
we develop an unsupervised method, ZL-Distiller, which leverages contextual language representations of the reviews and their distributional patterns to identify salient sentences about entities.
Salient Fact Extraction
